hypothesis: User values Premium but a different payer or chooser selects Basic
mechanism: Purchase authority and payment are separated from the specialist beneficiary.
observable_prediction: The user reports relevant benefit and preference; another household role controls the actual replacement and selects a lower-cost or shared option.
support: TikTok 7552195449504547585 contrasts parent-funded home use with kos price; TikTok 7425778994514150149 describes parental restrictions; Reddit jmz7mka describes spouse choice.
rival: Reddit jn2d5tk describes shared specialist use supported by the mother's sensitivity; a payer may willingly fund Premium.
falsifier: Eligible switchers control choice and payment, with no household constraint, yet still reject Premium for another reason.
primary_test: Reconstruct who noticed depletion, chose, ordered, paid and used the last two or three tubes; obtain a payer account only with permission.
target_applicability: Unknown; no confirmed target switching sequence
conditional_direction: Test household-relevant benefit or personal/shared tube logic only when the roles actually constrain purchase.

hypothesis: Independent purchasing changes the acceptable replacement outlay
mechanism: A formerly supplied product becomes a personal budget decision; the relevant alternative and reference point change.
observable_prediction: Payer transition precedes the first lower-priced replacement despite known product fit.
support: TikTok 7552195449504547585 directly contrasts parent-funded use with self-salient kos pricing.
rival: X 2015590249167274297 reports moving to a more expensive toothpaste after starting work; independence can support uptrading.
falsifier: Payment responsibility and available budget did not change at replacement, or the person continued Premium after self-funding.
primary_test: Identify moving/working/payment transition dates and compare the last household-funded with first personally funded purchase.
mechanism_confidence: Plausible; one direct context contrast plus a strong rival
target_applicability: Unknown age, exact paid prices and next product in public accounts
conditional_direction: Evaluate existing pack/cash-outlay access and appropriate targeting; do not assume all independent youth need cheaper products.

hypothesis: The desired exact variant is unavailable on the ordinary replenishment trip
mechanism: A satisfied user cannot obtain the intended SKU and accepts a convenient default.
observable_prediction: The user seeks a specific variant, finds it absent/inconvenient, and selects Basic or another product among actual alternatives.
support: LZD-1574262094522499 combines fit, bundle savings and reported unavailability; Reddit jmz6rv4 describes difficulty finding a Closeup variant.
rival: Official Indomaret 2025 Sensitive Expert 100 g promotions and current catalogues refute blanket channel absence.
falsifier: Desired SKU was visible and purchasable on the actual trip, but the buyer rejected it for cost, need or experience.
primary_test: Reconstruct exact store/date/SKU/alternatives and follow with a narrow local shelf check where the account warrants it.
mechanism_confidence: Plausible exact-SKU mechanism; blanket minimarket absence weakened
target_applicability: No verified target stockout-to-Basic sequence or national stockout rate
conditional_direction: Fix verified local replenishment execution before scaling demand creation.

hypothesis: The incremental benefit is not noticed or is judged by the wrong evaluation rule
mechanism: Extra cost is compared with a benefit that is irrelevant, slow, mismatched, or difficult for the buyer to observe.
observable_prediction: The person expected a defined result, did not perceive it within their chosen period, and links that disappointment to the next purchase.
support: TAR-117079 reports no visible whitening despite favorable score; TikTok 7425822711702553350 describes perceived Pepsodent non-relief then Sensodyne relief.
rival: TAR-161537 reports positive whitening; X 1600113707526524928 continues without visible change because comfort matters.
falsifier: Eligible switchers experienced the desired outcome and understood its ongoing value, yet chose Basic for an unrelated constraint.
primary_test: Ask expected outcome, evaluation period, noticed changes, proof standard, exact variant, and replacement consequence without giving a desired benefit first.
target_applicability: No representative benefit-failure rate or verified clinical comparison
conditional_direction: Test appropriate selection and expectation-setting for the specific need; verify supported claims.

hypothesis: Perceived symptom resolution removes the reason to keep paying more
mechanism: The buyer interprets specialist use as episodic treatment and returns to routine care after improvement.
observable_prediction: Improvement precedes Basic replacement, with an explicit belief that the specialist job is finished.
support: LZD-1200640450822499 expresses an until-resolved expectation but does not observe later discontinuation.
rival: Tokopedia 2145103290 links benefit to not wanting to switch;2177591268 reports long use and repeat; clinical episodic trial does not imply inevitable relapse.
falsifier: Improvement is followed by sustained repeat or stopping precedes improvement and is explained by another constraint.
primary_test: Reconstruct before/during/after symptom course, exact next product and reasoning; keep clinical guidance separate from commercial interviewing.
mechanism_confidence: Testable but weak direct evidence for actual stop-after-relief sequence
conditional_direction: Clarify appropriate ongoing value only if the endpoint interpretation is demonstrated; do not invent dependence or fear.

hypothesis: Sensory discomfort or poor fit outweighs the specialist promise
mechanism: Taste, foam, dryness, irritation, or mouthfeel makes continued use unattractive.
observable_prediction: A specific experienced sensation precedes and is explicitly connected to replacement.
support: TikTok 7425778994514150149 reports dark Pepsodent dryness;7581114937188221704 reports whitening-use discomfort then ordinary-product use; Enzim 1469837237 values low foam.
rival: Tokopedia 1932700850 reports Ultra White repurchase because cocok; different users prefer different sensory profiles.
falsifier: The user likes the experience and reports no adverse sensation, while the actual replacement is driven by payer, price or access.
primary_test: Ask spontaneous descriptions, timing, comparison, concurrent changes and link to purchase; do not diagnose ingredients or clinical harm.
mechanism_confidence: Direct reported experiences; heterogeneous and self-attributed
target_applicability: Unknown exact variants/ages in several accounts; no clinical causality
conditional_direction: Address verified need/experience fit and supported expectations, rather than assuming more foam or stronger mint is universally better.

hypothesis: Variant comparison is difficult enough to trigger a familiar default
mechanism: Need uncertainty and comparison effort make Basic an acceptable low-effort choice.
observable_prediction: The shopper struggles to choose a suitable Premium variant before rejecting price and defaults despite relevant need.
support: Portfolio complexity and conditional choice-overload literature make this worth testing; no observed target choice task yet.
rival: Experienced shoppers may benefit from variety; easy selection followed by price rejection is not overload.
falsifier: Participants identify the suitable variant confidently and quickly but reject it on economics or experience.
primary_test: Observe an actual need-based SKU comparison before offering guidance; record reasoning, uncertainty, fallback and effect of clarification.
mechanism_confidence: Conditional theoretical plausibility; direct local decision evidence limited
target_applicability: Unknown; product count is not a behavioural measure
conditional_direction: Improve a demonstrated decision difficulty using existing tools; avoid an undifferentiated new quiz.

hypothesis: Discounted trial is not repeated at the subsequent price
mechanism: Trial economics differ from replacement economics through cash constraint, reference price or weak underlying need.
observable_prediction: The same buyer tries at a deal, then knowingly rejects an actual later price and selects Basic, controlling for stock and need.
support: Deep case/example offers and requests for more discounts establish offer architecture and promotion interest, not the complete mechanism.
rival: Enzim 1469837237 and2310809324 combine long use/fit with deal language; promotion can subsidize loyalty or accelerate timing.
falsifier: Deal users later repeat at ordinary prices, or apparent nonrepeat is explained by remaining stock, larger packs or unrelated change.
primary_test: Obtain first and next paid prices, pack quantity, baseline use, stock at home and next actual purchase; compare like cohorts.
mechanism_confidence: Plausible; causal direction and magnitude unidentified
conditional_direction: Test sustained funded repeat and incrementality rather than optimizing trial volume alone.

hypothesis: A personal specialist need is funded through a shared household tube
mechanism: The incremental cost is spread across users with unequal needs and a faster shared depletion cycle.
observable_prediction: Only one person values the specialist benefit but multiple users consume it, and household replacement reverts to a general tube.
support: Household accounts establish shared products and unequal preferences; case pack economics makes the interaction possible.
rival: Reddit jn2d5tk and Tokopedia family-use accounts show shared specialist needs can justify household Premium.
falsifier: The tube is personal or several users value the specialist outcome, and sharing does not influence replacement.
primary_test: Map each user, need, tube, consumption arrangement and chooser; compare shared versus separate replenishment logic.
mechanism_confidence: Plausible household mechanism, not measured prevalence
target_applicability: No verified target household cost allocation or dose data
conditional_direction: Evaluate personal/shared product logic when practical and appropriately valued; do not assume sharing always harms Premium.

hypothesis: Basic is a rational sufficient final choice for some buyers
mechanism: The added specialist outcome has little incremental value relative to accepted routine care and recurring cost.
observable_prediction: The buyer can afford, find and understand Premium but prefers Basic because it already meets the actual job.
support: Case unit-price difference and varied evaluation rules make sufficiency a required rival; evidence does not establish clinical equivalence.
rival: Explicit benefit-driven repeat shows some needs sustain specialist value; a stated lack of need can also conceal misfit or low knowledge.
falsifier: An appropriately matched, experienced benefit changes the actual funded replacement, showing previously unrecognized value.
primary_test: Recruit satisfied Basic users and ask what success is, what would justify more, and what they would lose by changing; avoid shaming.
mechanism_confidence: Essential rational-choice rival; direct target applicability needs testing
target_applicability: Unknown addressable share; not every Basic buyer is a suitable Premium target
conditional_direction: Target appropriate durable needs and accept nonaddressable contexts rather than forcing universal uptrading.

hypothesis: Part of the observed mix change reflects accounting or purchase composition
mechanism: Denominator growth, realized price, pack size, channel mix, timing or tier definitions change reported share without equivalent individual abandonment.
observable_prediction: Mix changes differ from absolute Premium volume/revenue/household repeat after comparable-period and SKU adjustments.
support: Case discloses share movement; arithmetic admits several absolute outcomes; public corpus does not supply the needed transaction bridge.
rival: Organizer explicitly states downtrading; true individual Premium-to-Basic replacement may still contribute materially.
falsifier: Consistent longitudinal data show equivalent decline among comparable eligible buyers after controlling mix, timing and measurement.
primary_test: Seek organizer/company clarification on definitions; in interviews distinguish one Basic purchase, concurrent tubes and complete abandonment.
target_applicability: No private transaction or cohort data
conditional_direction: Define the business metric and magnitude before choosing reach, repeat or price objectives.
